My husband and I own almost four hectares in total, so this maize plot of a bit less than one hectare is important for feeding my family and selling a little at market. I will try to get DAP and urea from the cooperative like last year, though sometimes it comes late. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year and pesticide is expensive, so I save seed from last harvest and rely on my own hands and my children's help for weeding.
